title: Internet Service posters — Premium wifi

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Place a service beside familiar household benefits so readers understand its relevance to choosing a home.
strategic_value: The repeated final line can position Cox wifi as a desirable home amenity alongside architectural features.
demonstration: Three framed posters pair interior scenes with lists of home features that end in bold Premium wifi, followed by an offer and Cox signature.
practical_value: Use a repeated sentence structure to connect different images while giving the service benefit the strongest type weight.

content_islands.name: Three poster comparison
content_islands.spec: Align the three framed posters across a blue wall, preserving their distinct room scenes.

content_islands.name: Headline and offer
content_islands.spec: Place short feature lists in each image’s quiet space, with Premium wifi in bold and the smaller offer below.

content_islands.name: Shared signature
content_islands.spec: Align the welcome-home cue and Cox mark near the bottom of every poster.

ingredient.name: Premium wifi headline ending
ingredient.role: Make connectivity read as one of the home’s desirable features.
ingredient.application: List two architectural or interior features in light type and end with Premium wifi in bold. Keep the smaller offer immediately below.
ingredient.scope: The three residential Internet Service posters shown here. This is an observed campaign pattern, not a company-wide copy rule.
